# `plasma::D3D9Engine`

[Game reference](../README.md) › [ui](../ui.md) › `plasma::D3D9Engine`

- **Kind:** class, 0x2D0 bytes
- **Status:** verified (source: kyubu)
- **Builds:** Cube.exe, Cube.exe only
- **C:** `plasma_D3D9Engine` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.cast("plasma_D3D9Engine", address)`
- **Evidence:** `rtti:plasma::D3D9Engine`, `manual:render_init allocates 0x2D0 bytes for it`, `probe:title-scene`
- **Confirmed by:** [title-scene](../probes.md#title-scene)

the engine that owns the scene root, the fonts and the device. Bases plasma::Engine, plasma::ObjectManager; vtable 0x7214D4. One instance, in plasma::d3d9_engine and at cube::GameController.engine
